about_short_description.short_description: Goldbelly is an online delivery platform for specialty food makers and artisans.

product.name: Goldbelly Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for ordering specialty foods, prepared meals, desserts, regional dishes, and gourmet gifts from restaurants, chefs, and food makers.

product.name: Nationwide Food Delivery and Fulfillment
product.description: A delivery service that coordinates shipment of restaurant meals, regional specialties, desserts, and gourmet food gifts to residential and gift-recipient addresses.

product.name: Corporate Gifting
product.description: A business gifting service for sending Goldbelly food products or gift cards to multiple recipients, with self-service ordering and concierge support.

product.name: Goldbelly Gift Cards and E-Gifting
product.description: Physical and electronic gift options that let recipients select Goldbelly food products and schedule delivery using an email address, text message, or mailed card.

product.name: Goldbelly Subscriptions
product.description: Recurring food delivery offerings that provide subscribers with scheduled shipments of selected specialty foods or curated food experiences.

product.name: Goldbelly Rewards
product.description: A customer loyalty program that awards points for eligible purchases and allows members to redeem points for discounts on future Goldbelly orders.
